name: midday
description: time_ratio = 0.5 (halfway through the trading day by wall-clock). NOTE: half the wall-clock time does NOT yield half the decay; the log10 curve is concave so the decay at midday is ~0.74, NOT 0.5. This is exactly the spec the inline producer encodes (faster early-day tightening). A wrong impl that used a linear decay instead of log10 would diverge sharply here.
